rubric.role_summary: Strategic enterprise account executive selling a fraud and financial-crime risk platform to large companies, financial institutions, fintechs, neobanks, and digital asset exchanges. Owns pipeline development and complex sales processes through close.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Strategic enterprise account executive selling a fraud and financial-crime risk platform to large companies, financial institutions, fintechs, neobanks, and digital asset exchanges. Owns pipeline development and complex sales processes through close.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 5+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience.
- 3+ years of experience selling to fintechs and neobanks.
- Consultative sales experience conducting discovery sessions.
- Proficiency managing complex, multi-threaded sales cycles.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Specific expertise in fraud and compliance.
- 3+ years of proven success selling to fintechs and neobanks.
- An extensive network of industry executives and leaders.
- Experience structuring complex deals.
- Proven effectiveness working across a matrixed global organization spanning multiple geographies and time zones.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): United States; Canada. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
